data.name: Manraj
data.gender_notes: Manraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Manraj is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘manas’ meaning mind and ‘raj’ meaning ruler or king. This name signifies a person who rules their mind and thoughts, and is often associated with wisdom and intelligence. The name Manraj carries the meaning “Mind, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manraj usually hope their child will grow to embody mind, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes mastery over one's thoughts and emotions.
data.etymology: Manraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mind, Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manraj total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
